punchline: The certificate asked about race, tribe and nationality, and his mother knew each answer.
thirty_sec: When Trevor Noah was born very light-skinned, his mother told the doctors the father was from Swaziland and that he was born in KaNgwane. His certificate therefore does not call him Xhosa and does not name his father.
question: When did you last read, line by line, what the rule in front of you actually says?
key_contrast: Fearing a rule's shadow is not the same as reading its text.
